consentPaste: You pasted a dApp connection code.
consentLink: You opened a dApp connection link. The dApp may be open in another tab or on another device.
consentProtocol: A dApp is requesting to connect to your wallet via QRL Connect.
consentWarning: Connecting establishes an encrypted channel and does not share an account. The dApp's name and site are pinned after the channel is established, and account access requires a separate approval. Only continue if you just clicked Connect in a dApp, opened its connection link, or pasted its connection code yourself.
accountRequired: Create or import an account first so you can approve a later account access request from the dApp.
sessionsSubtitle: dApps paired with this wallet over the end-to-end encrypted QRL Connect relay.
identityChanging: Wallet identity is changing; retry the connection
identityChanged: Wallet identity changed during QRL Connect operation
identityReading: Wallet identity changed while reading the connection
identityOpening: Wallet identity changed while opening the connection
sessionLocked: This QRL Connect session is active in another wallet tab, or this browser cannot safely lock it
relayRestricted: This wallet pairs only through the qrlwallet.com relay. Ask the dApp to use it, or pair from the web wallet.
publicKeyPending: dApp has not registered its public key with the relay yet; retry the scan
fingerprintMismatch: Relay-provided public key does not match the fingerprint from the QR
clearingConnection: Previous wallet connection is still being cleared
qrMismatch: Scanned QR does not match the already-connected dApp for this channel
relayList: Relay returned an invalid buffered message list
relayMessage: Relay returned a malformed buffered message
relayKey: Relay returned an invalid ML-KEM public key
relayTerminated: Relay reported a terminated or malformed channel
relayTooMany: Relay returned too many buffered messages
relayChannelKey: Relay returned a malformed channel public key
relayStatus: Relay returned a malformed termination status
uriLegacy: qrUri: legacy v1 URI - this wallet requires a PQP3 dApp
uriCrypto: qrUri: WebCrypto SubtleCrypto is not available
uriLegacyPqp: qrUri: legacy {{version}} URI - regenerate the QR with @qrlwallet/connect 4 or newer
